gate.bar: Gate 1W (plan section 4): whole-step time of Mono WebAssembly AOT, one thread, at most 1.25x the TypeScript worker's, on desktop Chromium and on the phone's WebView
gate.measured: kernel level only (the two frozen speed-test kernels, scalar contract path), AOT / TypeScript alone: node|stencil 0.85 (0.84-1.07); in-process A B B A 0.84; node|copy 1.17 (1.13-1.21); in-process A B B A 0.76; chromium|stencil 0.94 (0.89-0.98); in-process A B B A 0.92; chromium|copy 0.95 (0.91-1.00); in-process A B B A 0.93
gate.why: The gate is defined on the whole simulation step on desktop Chromium and the phone WebView; this early reading measures two kernels in the container only. At kernel level the worst round of any scalar-path cell is 1.21x.

notRun: the whole step as WebAssembly (T6.4, T1.6b)
